ideas.pitch: Automated satellite imagery surveillance platform detecting unauthorized construction and environmental degradation along the Visakhapatnam coastline.
ideas.title: Visakhapatnam Coastal Zone AI Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages localized geospatial tracking similar to GeoNex-ATLAS which won 2nd runner-up at Xcelerate Hackathon, directly appealing to regional infrastructure and environmental compliance judges.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent coordination dashboard optimizing container freight transit and vessel turnaround times for the Visakhapatnam Port Authority.
ideas.title: Port Logistics Multi-Agent Scheduler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven multi-agent orchestration frameworks seen in greenrovation-ai-platform to a high-impact local industrial logistics domain.

ideas.pitch: Decentralized marketplace with instant escrow payments for local fishermen to sell their catch directly to regional distributors without predatory middlemen.
ideas.title: Andhra Fisherfolk Safe-Catch Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the successful escrow marketplace architecture from Dispatch which won 1st place at the Synthesis Hackathon, providing a fully functional transaction workflow.

ideas.pitch: Graph intelligence and LightGBM-powered anomaly detection system for local municipal power distribution to identify electricity theft and meter tampering.
ideas.title: Vizag Smart Grid AML & Fraud Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the Focal LightGBM and graph intelligence pipeline from Bito which won 1st place at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven local crop and dietary recommendation engine tailored to regional agricultural yields and traditional Andhra nutritional profiles.
ideas.title: Coastal Agro-Nutrition & Crop Advisor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Built on the rapid recommendation UI patterns of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant which won first prize at Hour Hackathon, ensuring a polished frontend presentation.
